style_summary: A premium kinetic advertising system built around a worm's-eye ultra-wide photograph, one monumental foreground product or prop, a dynamic human figure receding behind it, giant edge-cropped diagonal neo-grotesk typography, restrained technical microcopy, and a near-black-to-luminous-color gradient field. The finish is sparse but forceful: commercial photocompositing, selective blur, soft bloom, rim light, and layered type create speed and depth without visual clutter.

environment_variables.SUBJECT: one new human subject appropriate to the campaign concept, with no copied identity
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: one clear dynamic action that interacts with the new product or prop
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: one new logo-free hero product or physical prop that can dominate the foreground
environment_variables.LOCATION: a sparse campaign environment or abstracted real setting
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: a near-black frame, one luminous gradient field, atmospheric haze, cropped geometric fragments, and restrained depth cues
environment_variables.MAIN_TEXT: one short new uppercase headline, ideally four to eight letters
environment_variables.SECONDARY_TEXT: a compact new technical label plus one or two short lines of supporting copy
environment_variables.ACCENT_SYMBOL: one simple new numeric fragment, code, glyph, or geometric mark
environment_variables.WARDROBE_STYLE: minimal contemporary wardrobe suited to the new subject, without logos
environment_variables.STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS: observable style traits that must remain visible in every sample
environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: literal source content that generated samples must not recreate

style_fidelity_anchors: A single human subject and one hero object dominate an otherwise sparse premium advertising composition.
Extreme worm's-eye ultra-wide perspective creates pronounced foreground foreshortening.
The featured object occupies roughly the lower third to half of the frame and is partially cropped by an edge.
The person sits behind the object in the middle depth plane, with a smaller comparatively shadowed face and torso.
Subject, object, and typography share one energetic bottom-corner-to-opposite-top diagonal movement.
Monumental white uppercase neo-grotesk letterforms are rotated, fragmented, and cropped beyond the canvas.
Large type alternates between sitting behind the figure and emerging around it to create layered depth.
A compact lower-corner information block uses a bold italic label followed by very small italic descriptive copy.
The upper region retains substantial near-black negative space with only one or two tiny unbranded marks.
Palette behavior uses near-black framing, one saturated luminous color field, pale white highlights, and one restrained secondary accent.
Clean commercial photocompositing combines selective sharpness, shallow-focus blur, motion haze, soft bloom, and colored light spill.
The mood is fast, youthful, technical, aspirational, and slightly futuristic, with no borders, panels, or dense graphic clutter.
source_content_to_avoid: Nike, the Swoosh, JUST DO IT, Pegasus, Pegasus 42, ReactX, Air Zoom, and every line of source campaign copy.
The exact white running shoe, teal side mark, sole construction, or recognizable source product silhouette.
A male runner stepping toward the camera, the exact raised-knee running pose, or a daily-running story premise.
The original white long-sleeve top, black shorts, white crew socks, and white footwear combination.
The exact PEGASUS42 letter sequence, the number 42, and the original arrangement of those characters.
The source face, body silhouette, action, performance-footwear narrative, or exact product-foot interaction.
The exact source layout traced element for element, including identical word placement and identical subject crop.
Any copied logo, slogan, brand mark, watermark, signature, creator ID, platform mark, or identifiable campaign identity.

visual_deconstruction.overall_style_category: Contemporary kinetic product-ad photomontage with a premium editorial campaign finish.
visual_deconstruction.composition_and_layout: A single monumental product or prop fills the lower foreground while one human figure rises behind it along a strong diagonal. Giant white letter fragments pass behind and around the body. The top stays dark and quiet; a small information block anchors a lower corner.
visual_deconstruction.subject_placement: The product or prop is the nearest and largest layer, usually cropped by the bottom or side edge. The human subject occupies the central-to-upper middle plane, with limbs creating a diagonal bridge toward the far corner.
visual_deconstruction.camera_angle_or_perspective: An extreme ground-level worm's-eye view through an ultra-wide lens exaggerates the nearest object and compresses the figure behind it. A blurred near-edge sliver can intensify forward motion.
visual_deconstruction.typography_style: Huge white geometric neo-grotesk uppercase type is tightly tracked, rotated, fragmented, and cropped. Small supporting copy is italic, technical, and low-contrast in scale rather than color.
visual_deconstruction.color_palette_behavior: Near-black at the perimeter transitions through one saturated glow into pale white atmospheric light. A deeper version of the glow color provides the product accent.
visual_deconstruction.graphic_elements: Oversized letter fragments, one short numeric or coded fragment, a tiny unbranded top mark, minimal geometric cuts, and one lower-corner technical copy block.
visual_deconstruction.texture_and_finish: Polished digital compositing with crisp product detail, slightly softer human detail, clean masks, subtle motion blur, soft atmospheric bloom, and no visible paper grain.
visual_deconstruction.lighting: The foreground object receives the brightest clean highlight and colored rim light. The body is backlit or rim-lit while the face remains comparatively shadowed.
visual_deconstruction.mood_and_cultural_reference: High-energy premium launch campaign, youth performance culture, experimental editorial typography, and futuristic technical confidence.

composition.primary_structure: Three depth planes: a blurred near-edge streak, a sharply rendered monumental foreground product or prop, and a darker human figure behind it, all crossing a giant diagonal type field.
composition.negative_space: Reserve a broad near-black upper band or corner with only one or two tiny identity-like marks; avoid filling every gap.
composition.subject_scale: The product or prop occupies 35 to 50 percent of the canvas, while the human figure occupies approximately 25 to 40 percent and feels smaller because of perspective.
composition.diagonal_flow: Drive the eye from the oversized foreground corner through the body and headline toward the opposite upper corner.
composition.layer_order: gradient atmosphere, giant type, selected type fragments, human figure, monumental product, selective foreground blur, microcopy

aspect_ratio_notes.4:5: Stack the product in the lower half, let the person rise through the center, preserve a dark upper pocket, and rotate the headline steeply enough to crop at two edges.
aspect_ratio_notes.5:4: Place the product across one lower corner, stretch the person and headline diagonally through the wide field, and keep the far upper corner sparse and dark.

typography.headline: Monumental bold uppercase geometric neo-grotesk, white, tightly tracked, rotated roughly 25 to 40 degrees, fragmented by crop, and partially occluded by the subject.
typography.secondary: Bold italic all-caps technical label plus one or two lines of very small italic sans-serif copy in a lower corner.
typography.numeric_fragment: Use one short code or number as a large secondary type fragment on the diagonal, never the source number 42.
typography.text_behavior: Treat headline letters as a structural depth layer, not as a centered caption; preserve legible fragments while allowing purposeful cropping.
typography.avoid: brand logos, copied campaign wording, centered title cards, ornate serif display type, long paragraphs, multiple competing headlines, outlines, bevels, or heavy 3D extrusion

photographic_direction.lens: 14 to 20 mm equivalent ultra-wide lens placed at ground or product level, with strong but plausible perspective distortion.
photographic_direction.focus: Keep the hero product or prop crisply resolved; let the person, face, and near-edge motion soften selectively without becoming unrecognizable.
photographic_direction.lighting: Bright diffused glow from below or behind, colored rim light on the product, shadowed upper body, and a controlled near-black vignette.
photographic_direction.post_processing: Clean premium cutout composite, smooth gradient atmosphere, soft bloom, directional motion haze, subtle chromatic spill, strong local contrast, and no noisy grain.
photographic_direction.anatomy_and_geometry: Maintain plausible limbs, hands, face, object geometry, labels, and contact points despite the extreme perspective.

design_rules: Use exactly one principal human subject and one monumental logo-free hero product or prop.
Put the camera at product level and let the nearest object dominate through foreshortening rather than simple scaling.
Build one clear diagonal shared by object, body, and headline.
Keep the upper region sparse and near-black while the lower or middle region blooms into one saturated glow and pale white.
Set one short new uppercase headline as huge diagonal white fragments behind and around the subject.
Add only one large code fragment, one tiny top mark, and one compact lower-corner technical text block.
Render the product sharper and brighter than the face to preserve the commercial hierarchy.
Use selective blur and haze as depth cues, not as global softness or noisy degradation.
Change the subject, action, object, text, wardrobe, setting, and story from the source.
Keep all identity elements generic, original, and unbranded.
do: Use an extreme worm's-eye commercial camera angle.
Make one foreground object monumental and partially cropped.
Layer giant diagonal white type behind and around the human figure.
Preserve dark negative space and a single luminous gradient color field.
Use clean photoreal compositing, rim light, soft bloom, and selective motion blur.
Keep the campaign sparse, premium, technical, and logo-free.
avoid: Running shoes, runners, raised-knee running poses, the source wardrobe, or the source performance-footwear story.
Nike, Swoosh-like marks, Pegasus, JUST DO IT, the number 42, or any copied source wording.
Dense collage layouts, many products, multiple people, UI panels, stickers, borders, price tags, or retail clutter.
Flat vector art, illustration-only rendering, 3D clay renders, storyboard frames, HTML mockups, or canvas substitutes.
Centered horizontal headlines, decorative serif type, rainbow palettes, busy textures, film grain, or glitch noise.
Malformed anatomy, broken object geometry, unreadable main text, random pseudo-logos, watermarks, QR codes, or barcodes.
